full_judgment:
Shah Abu Nayeem Mominur Rahman J: The instant leave petition filed under Article 103 of the Constitution is against the judgment and order dated 12.01.09 passed by the High Court Division making the Rule absolute issued in Civil Revision No. 2084 of 2004 and thereby setting aside the judgment and order passed by the District Judge, Pabna, allowing the appeal and remanding the Miscellaneous Case No. 81 of 2002 for disposal afresh, on setting aside the judgment and order passed by the learned Joint District Judge, 2nd Court, Pabna, dismissing the miscellaneous case. 

 2. The miscellaneous case was preferred by the defendant Nos.1-4 of Partition Suit No. 1 of 1996, which has been decreed ex-parte on 30.06.2002. 

 3. The aforesaid defendants filed the miscellaneous case under Order IX Rule 13 of the Code of Civil Procedure for restoration of the suit to its original file and number after setting the ex-parte decree dated 30.06.2002. The trial Court framed the following issues: 

 4. On consideration of the materials and evidences on record the trial Court found all the issues against the defendant-petitioners and in particular the case was found to be barred by limitation. 

 5. Being aggrieved the defendant-petitioners preferred miscellaneous appeal before the District Judge, Pabna, who heard and disposed of the Misc. Appeal No. 50 of 2003 and on consideration of the materials on record and the submissions of then learned Advocates of the contesting parties allowed the appeal setting the judgment and order passed by the Court below and further remanded back the case for fresh adjudication.
